company.name: Biobot Analytics
company.shortDescription: Real-time, privacy-first health intelligence. The world's first and most advanced wastewater intelligence platform.
company.description: Biobot is the pioneer and market leader in wastewater epidemiology intelligence with a mission to deliver population-level health insights across various infectious diseases and high risk substances. Customers include federal, state and local governments, pharmaceutical companies, universities, and more. Founded at MIT in 2017, Biobot's vision is that healthcare intelligence is inclusive and proactive.

aiResearchSummary.text: The title Modular system for upstream wastewater sampling and its abstract describe a wastewater sampling system with an inlet tube, outlet port, high flow circuit, pump, and sampling circuit configured to collect representative upstream wastewater. Biobot Analytics is researching and developing modular systems that improve how wastewater is sampled and routed, supporting reliable collection of sewage for population level health analysis, wastewater monitoring, and upstream wastewater sampling infrastructure.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $13,400,000, or 32.37% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,836,936 to $121,591,396, a 42.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 89 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
